summary: Frontend-only test of the Pokelike lanes, seeded boss/miniboss pools, miniboss rewards, Medaglia del Checkpoint and the canon v2 roster. Tested with Playwright at 400x860 on the preview URL, plus a node check that ran runPlan/actMap/edgesFrom on 3000 seeds. Everything requested passes except one crash, found and fixed. The crash: tapping perk-offer-skip ('Nessun vantaggio') threw 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading filter)' in App.js onPickPerks whenever run.perks was undefined, which is the case for every fresh run. It happened both on the start-of-run offer and on the offer after the boss consequence, so a player who skipped the perk was stuck on the perk screen. I fixed it with (r.perks || []) and retested: both cases now pass. Verified: (1) act-intro-bosses shows 'Miniboss W5: X · Boss W10: Y'. W1 has 3 enabled nodes. After each node only the same and adjacent lanes are enabled at the next wave (W2 [1,2], W3 [0,1,2], W4 [1,2], W5 [0,1,2]). After a reload the enabled nodes, aria-labels and overworld.path are identical. (2) All 3 W5 nodes are type miniboss (ow-type-miniboss, aria-label shows the team name 'Occult'), and map-miniboss-team shows in the preview. After the win, miniboss-reward-screen shows exactly 2 options plus miniboss-skip, and the options are the same after a reload. Picking the recruit added Nata Juuzou (pixel avatar). The spirit pick set spiritUnlocked=true on Mark. The item pick added fischietto. reward-notice is correct in all 3 cases. The natural W15 offer was spirit + recruit Ares. (3) The W10 boss node showed the seeded team (Royal Academy, matching the intro), with boss-intro, battle and consequence-exclusive text. items.medaglia=1 and the notice reads 'Ricompensa esclusiva del boss: Medaglia del Checkpoint.' Using the medal in TeamScreen gave bonus +4/+4/+4/+12 and maxHp 361->373. (4) 5 new runs gave 2 distinct intros (4x Occult/Royal, 1x Royal/Occult). Seed check over 3000 seeds: W10 is ~50/50, W20 never equals W10, W30 always has 2 distinct branch bosses, W50 is always little-gigant, every miniboss row has 3 miniboss nodes, every non-final node has 2-3 edges and each act has 3 rivals. Across those seeds W40 drew all 8 pool teams with roughly equal frequency. (5) W30 shows 2 boss nodes (Prominence / Epsilon Kai). The W40 boss was Fire Dragon. W50 is 'Little Gigant' with Rococo Urupa + Maxi Kuu + Shinti Hanpa, and the second enemy, Ghoshu Flare, renders a procedural pixel avatar. Winning W50 goes to game-over-screen 'CAMPIONI!' with journey-log. (6) Regression: the rival node (act1 W6, Royal Academy, rival=true) leads to the reward screen. The perk offer appears after the boss consequence and the pick is saved. The anomaly (contentSeed=1, W13 act2:13:0) Mixi Max with Torch gives notice +10% ATK. Jest: 116 passed, 2 failed (same 2 unrelated failures as before).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT: runPerkFx({perks: r.perks.filter(...)}) crashed when run.perks was undefined (newRun does not initialise perks). The trigger was perk-offer-skip, or confirm with zero picks, at run start or after the boss consequence. The perk screen stayed frozen and a runtime overlay appeared. Changed to (r.perks || []).

issues: The boss/elite intro line appears twice in battle-log, for example 'Finale del FFI...' twice. This comes from the React StrictMode double-run of the intro useEffect. It only happens in dev, but it can be avoided with a ref guard.

action_items: Initialise perks: [] in newRun/normalizeRun so other code paths that read run.perks without a guard cannot crash. App.js onPickPerks is already guarded.
Optional: MINIBOSS_ITEMS includes 'bibita' (UNCOMMON) although the spec says 'rare item'. Consider limiting the list to RARE/EPIC non-exclusive items.
Optional: guard against the double battle intro line under StrictMode.
critical_code_review_comments: newRun() does not create run.perks. Every read must use (run.perks || []); onPickPerks was the one that did not.

runPlan: the W25 miniboss is always the act-3 team that is NOT a W30 branch boss, because both share the same 3-team pool. The W5 miniboss is the W10 team's opposite unless W20 used it. The W35 miniboss is alius-sel about 90% of the time. This is consistent with the 'avoid repeats' rule, but there is little variety.
In actMap the junctions set is computed but no longer used (dead code since the change to Pokelike edges).
Act 5 rival (Unicorn), W40 boss and W45 miniboss can all be Unicorn in the same run, because the rival pool is not considered in runPlan. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the 1-line fix (all 6 requested feature groups verified)

seed_data_creation: None; only browser localStorage in fresh Playwright contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Jump: edit inazuma_rogue_run wave=N, pending=null, overworld.completedWave=N-1, path=[], selectedNodeId=null, introSeen=act index, then reload and click continue-run-btn. Boost the team with level 40, base.atk/def and atk/def set to 3000/5000. The boss node testid is map-node-actX:boss:<bossId>, and miniboss nodes are row 4 (W5/15/25/35/45, testid map-node-actX:W:lane). The anomaly for contentSeed=1 is now at act2:13:0 (it was W14 before). The training node has training-team-xp. Unlock perks in a test with meta.perks={tiro:1,muro:1,vento:1}. The perk card testid is perk-offer-<id>. The miniboss-reward options can be injected through pending.options to test spirit/item picks.
